events.body:
## Outcome

ForkMesh lets developers collaborate on, mirror, and preserve source-code repositories across independent hosts—without relying on any single hosting provider.

## Scope

- Use the same sentence on the homepage, repository profile, README, onboarding, and commercial material.
- Pair the promise with a short proof path: collaborate, add a mirror, take the source host offline, and clone again.
- Test the wording with maintainers, contributors, and operators; retain familiar developer terminology.

## Acceptance criteria

- Every primary surface uses the approved sentence without contradictory positioning.
- At least 80% of five-person usability cohorts can accurately restate the three jobs and the no-single-provider benefit.
- Each claim links to a working product action or an explicitly marked roadmap item.
- Linked automated evidence covers supported platforms, failure paths, rollback/recovery, documentation, and telemetry before closure.

## Delivery and dependencies

- Portfolio tier: **P0 release gate**
- Milestone: **Product contract & measurement**
- Numeric priority: **1 of 44** (1 is highest)
- Depends on: None
- Assignee: unassigned until an accountable owner accepts the epic; fund independently releasable child issues rather than this umbrella epic.

## Progress baseline

**70% as of 2026-07-22.** A close version already exists in repository metadata and README copy; wording, proof, and cross-surface validation remain. Progress may not exceed 85% without end-to-end validation or 95% without security, documentation, telemetry, and rollout evidence.

## Verification and measures

Primary measures: Promise comprehension, homepage-to-clone conversion, and unsupported-claim count. Closure requires linked test runs, operational evidence, and current user-facing documentation.
events.title: Publish one clear product promise
